forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
This week in week 36, 4 survey teams and 4 clearance teams were active. Teams completed 2 zone surveys and 2 visits; there were no technical surveys or clearances. So far, 26 zones have been surveyed, 9 declared free, 27 areas released and 12 cleared.

No teams were stood down or without a report for more than a week. No dossiers or reports were held or queried. The access feed shows 8 zones closed. A new plan, P09, was approved this week.

The week 36 forecast, for the zones of the plan it was made with and counting what is done already, gives a P10 to P90 range of 11 to 14 mine areas cleared this season and 10 to 10 zones declared free.
